name: Box office: printed tickets, membership sales, staff shifts
description: Selling and admitting at the counter. **Printed tickets**: a paper ticket carries a one-time print code instead of a static barcode; it admits once, a reprint voids the last paper, and while it is live the ticket's app and wallet codes are refused (docs/wallet.md "Printed tickets"). **Membership reservations**: hold a capacity-limited membership for 10 minutes while the member pays at the counter, then complete or cancel it (docs/memberships.md). **Staff shifts**: staff clock in and out with their own token; owners and managers read the hours (docs/pos.md). Plus moving a tag assignment to another tag. Personal access tokens made with "works across all my organizations" may also act in another organization of their user with the `X-Exos-Org` header; a pinned token naming another organization gets 403 `token_pinned_to_org` (docs/developer-platform.md).

endpoints.description: Mints the ticket's one-time print code and answers it with what goes on the paper. Exos prints no static barcode: the code admits once (the door spends it with the ticket), voids the ticket's last paper, and while it is live the ticket's app and wallet codes are refused at the door. A transfer, refund or new secret voids it. The code is in this answer only (Exos keeps its SHA-256), so a retry prints again; an Idempotency-Key is not replayed here. `format=html` / `format=pdf` answer the page or PDF to print (Cache-Control: no-store); any ticket printer prints the PDF through its driver. Opendate's POST /confirms/:confirm_id/tickets/:barcode/print is an alias, the confirm id pinning the event. Needs a key created by an owner or manager. docs/wallet.md "Printed tickets".

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ticket's id (or its app or print code).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (default): the codes; html: a printable page; pdf: a PDF, one 4 x 8 in page per ticket.

responses.description: Printed (format=json; html and pdf answer the document).

endpoints.description: Holds one place on the product for 10 minutes while the member pays at the counter: cash, a check, or a card on your own terminal (`external`). Complete it once the money is in hand; cancel it to back out; if neither happens it expires and the place frees up. The product must be published and active. Opendate's POST /membership_products/:id/membership_reservations is an alias and its wrapped body (`membership_reservation[email]`) is read too; `use_card_reader` and `gift` are refused (no card reader, no gifts at the box office) rather than ignored, and `membership_product_price_id` is ignored (a product has one price). Needs a key created by an owner or manager. docs/memberships.md.
